sum: Stewards Inc. offers alternative financing solutions to small and mid-sized businesses in the United States. It operates through Financing Solutions and Real Estate Operations segments. The company provides revenue-based funding and related financing products; and operates a direct and syndication revenue-based funding platform. It also offers equipment financing, business term loans, merchant cash advances, and line of credit. The company was formerly known as FAVO Capital, Inc. and changed its name to Stewards Inc. in October 2025. Stewards Inc. was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Fort Lauderdale, Florida.
